# uem_mac_applications (Data Source)

## Known limitation

Results aren't filtered to macOS or internal applications: the underlying search (AppsV2)
has no app-family filter, so this data source returns the same set as `uem_applications`,
optionally scoped by `organization_group_uuid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_group_uuid" {
  type        = string
  description = "Organization group UUID to search for macOS applications within"
}

data "uem_mac_applications" "example" {
  organization_group_uuid = var.organization_group_uuid
}

output "example_mac_application_uuids" {
  value = data.uem_mac_applications.example.mac_applications[*].uuid
}
```
